# Hafiz Jamali — portfolio of useful systems

Portfolio of Hafiz Jamali (github.com/H4fizWasabie): production systems built and operated, not demos.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/): systems overview, live telemetry of running services
- [Theoses](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/theoses): self-hosted AI agent + ops harness behind this page
- [Procura](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/procura): veterinary clinic procurement & inventory platform
- [PIMS](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/pims): practice information management system
- [MAP](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/map): Android, local-first mapping app
- [DD Drugs Register](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/dd-drugs-register): controlled-drugs register
- [Hills AI Content Lab](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/work/hills-ai-content-lab): AI-assisted content operations
- [Resume](https://portfolio.wasabietech.com/resume)
